subject: Pod runtime is 0.2.43 and HF deps now use hf_xet - H3 is already fully installed, and I need your GPU-image number
body:
Read this BEFORE you create a Pod. The Pod runtime changed under you this session and one of your gates is already cleared.

1. THE DEV RUNTIME CHANNEL IS NOW WRAPPER 0.2.43, not 0.2.41. Any dev-mode Pod you create boots it from R2 automatically (bootstrap.sh fetches wrapper.py + start-cpu.sh at boot). Confirm with /remote/comfy/status -> wrapperVersion. If you see 0.2.41 the fetch failed and you are on the baked copy.

2. HUGGINGFACE DEPS NO LONGER USE aria2. MPI-491 added _download_hf, a Xet-native transport, ahead of httpx. Order is _download_hf then _download_httpx then aria2 for non-HF. R2 (101 deps) and github (14 deps) are UNCHANGED and still on aria2 - only the 6 huggingface.co deps moved. Measured on h3-qwen3vl-32b-clip, same dep and volume: aria2 16-connection 1.66 MB/s, single-stream httpx 1.74, hf_xet 541 peak. About 320x.

3. YOUR GATE E DOWNLOAD BLOCKER IS GONE. All five MiniMax H3 deps are INSTALLED on volume aghcuvg7nl right now: minimax-h3-fl2va-transformer, minimax-h3-ref2va-transformer, h3-qwen3vl-32b-clip, vae-minimax-h3-video, vae-minimax-h3-audio. About 46GB, pulled in roughly 2.5 minutes of transfer against a projected 10 hours. Verify with POST /comfy/models/check before assuming, but do not re-download them.

4. THE GPU IMAGE PATH IS UNTESTED AND I NEED YOUR NUMBER. Everything above was measured on the slim -cpu image, where huggingface_hub had to be pip-installed at boot by start-cpu.sh. The GPU image already bakes huggingface-hub 1.26.0 and hf-xet 1.6.0 via python_deps.txt, so _download_hf should engage with no pip step - but that is INFERRED, not measured. If you install any HF dep on a GPU Pod, please sample /comfy/downloads/status every 15s and record the rate on MPI-491. Sample at 15s or not at all: the throttled shape bursts and collapses, so one long interval reads about 2x optimistic.
   Failure mode is SAFE either way: _download_hf returns None when it does not apply and raises on real failure, and both fall through to httpx. Worst case is slow, never broken. If an HF dep crawls, check Pod stdout for 'hf_xet path failed' - that is the fallback firing and the reason.

5. MY LEFTOVERS, both harmless but yours to clear. Pod 9d0dndbxd2xsh4 is a __cpu__ download Pod still RUNNING on aghcuvg7nl, and the user's app on :3000 is connected to it. Delete or replace it before you create a GPU Pod, so the one-Pod-per-account orphan sweep does not fire between you and it. Also sdxl-realistic (6.6GB) is now on the volume - it was my R2 control and completed before I could cancel. Real model, harmless, but it was not there before.

6. DO NOT RUN publish-runtime.sh promote. 0.2.43 is dev-only on purpose: one clean run is not two, and the GPU path in item 4 is exactly what is missing. Promote lands on released users.

Full measurement record including the wrong first hypothesis (I predicted single-stream would win; it lost at 1.74 vs 1.66, and an R2 control on the same Pod at 297 MB/s is what settled it) is in .agents/mpi-kanban/tasks/MPI-491/validation.md. Doc half is docs/download-manager.md, written but uncommitted because you have unstaged work in it.
resolution: Resolved 2026-08-10 by mpi-cleanup, on the user's call: leftovers, nobody is using them. The whole thread ran MPI-491 -> MPI-467 and BOTH cards are now done/complete. The one action aimed at a live card (af21aa8f, add a 1.4 gate to MPI-450) was WITHDRAWN by 9805e50a in the same thread, because mpi-release already stops on the manifest diff. Nothing here is outstanding.
